records.rule: System/370 instructions are 1, 2 or 3 halfwords. Primary opcode high bits participate in length/format classification; individual descriptions override general rules.
Unassigned/invalid operation codes take a program interruption; do not create OPxx implementations for intentionally invalid guest diagnostics.
Store complete program-old PSW at low core 0x28 and load complete program-new PSW from 0x68 for BC-mode program interruptions; ILC/address reflect architectural exception semantics.
SVC stores current PSW at 0x20 and loads the complete SVC-new PSW from 0x60.
For D/5D, odd R1 causes specification exception before the second operand is fetched; a zero divisor is irrelevant to that historical case.

MVN operates left-to-right, one byte at a time; destination high nibble survives and source low nibble replaces destination low nibble. Overlap therefore observes earlier writes when they become later source bytes.
records.project_proof: safety20 exact MVT retry + destructive-overlap regression

records.rule: UNPK is defined as if processed right-to-left; overlap must preserve that architectural processing model.

records.rule: Packed-decimal instruction family includes AP, CP, DP, ED, EDMK, MP, SRP, SP and ZAP, with instruction-specific condition-code and decimal exception behavior.
System/370 floating point is hexadecimal HFP. Preserve IBM fraction width, hexadecimal normalization, rounding/truncation and exceptions; do not substitute host IEEE behavior.

Resolve semantics independently, retry the exact historical state via journal/live method insertion, require plausible guest progress, prove candidate-to-permanent equivalence, then seal before the next unknown boundary.

Keep IBM_DOC, EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE, PROJECT_EVIDENCE guest proof, permanent-source replay proof, and SEALED_CHECKPOINT as separate claim levels. A green exact-state replay is not a sealed artifact until manifest/fresh-extraction packaging completes.

When a System/370 primary opcode is proven unassigned, deliver the architecturally correct operation exception through the generic classifier/interruption path and keep OPxx absent. Architecture generation remains part of the classification.

aliases: use arg parse arg object identity
records.rule: Use use arg for machine/CPU/storage/journal/executor and other object-bearing helper arguments so object identity is preserved. Use parse arg for textual/scalar command-line parsing.
The s370mvs sphere is maintained independently of emulator safety checkpoints. Sphere updates may record newly qualified knowledge without being bundled into or redefining an emulator checkpoint.

For System/370 short/long hexadecimal floating-point instructions, the R field may designate only floating-point registers 0, 2, 4, or 6. Other selectors cause specification exception before the instruction modifies its operand.

records.rule: When EX constructs a transient target instruction, do not reduce a target architectural exception to generic UNSUPPORTED_EX_TARGET. Preserve the exact historical EX state and establish IBM-defined interruption attribution (ILC/instruction address/old PSW) before permanent promotion.
